nodes.label: Honest Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Relationships retain EXTRACTED, INFERRED, or AMBIGUOUS provenance so uncertainty remains visible.

nodes.label: Existing Graph Fast Path
nodes.rationale: Natural-language codebase questions should query an existing graph directly to avoid unnecessary detection and extraction.

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: A read-only integrity gate exposes dangling endpoints, missing endpoints, self-loops, and collapsed directed edges without aborting a usable build.

nodes.label: Deterministic Node IDs
nodes.rationale: Repository-relative deterministic identifiers must align semantic results with AST extraction and prevent duplicate nodes across rebuilds.

nodes.label: Monorepo Subgraph Merge
nodes.rationale: Each local subfolder is extracted into its own output directory so independent runs do not clobber a shared project-root graphify-out directory.

nodes.label: Constrained Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: Queries are expanded only with tokens present in graph labels because the matcher has no stemming, synonym, or cross-language support.

nodes.label: Saved Query Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Saving answers, cited nodes, expanded tokens, outcomes, and corrections lets later updates learn useful sources and avoid known dead ends.

nodes.label: Replace on Re-Extraction
nodes.rationale: Changed source files are replaced during merge so stale nodes do not survive incremental updates.

nodes.label: Safe File Operations
nodes.rationale: Recursive and batch deletion are forbidden; each deletion must target one explicit file.

nodes.label: Explicit Validation Authorization
nodes.rationale: Builds, tests, AutoCAD launches, CAD scripts, and ASD validation run only when the user explicitly requests them.

nodes.label: Graphify-First Codebase Navigation
nodes.rationale: Existing graph queries, paths, explanations, and wiki navigation should scope codebase investigation before broad source browsing.

nodes.label: Legacy Loose-Hole Global-Boundary Rule
nodes.rationale: The legacy rules prohibited loose/scatter HoleLocation dimensions from using local boundary placement unless the user changed the rule.

nodes.label: 2026-05-28 Loose-Hole Boundary Decision
nodes.rationale: The handoff records a historical decision that loose/scatter HoleLocation dimensions should not use local boundary placement while pin distance dimensions may.

nodes.label: Versioned Test DLL Policy
nodes.rationale: Fresh versioned output paths avoid overwriting DLLs locked by AutoCAD and preserve regression traceability.

nodes.label: Fresh Versioned Regression Builds
nodes.rationale: Core tests and plugin builds consume separate never-reused -vNNN folders so binaries and evidence remain attributable.

nodes.label: Trace and Report Archiving
nodes.rationale: Each direction is archived immediately because diagnostics/last-run.json is overwritten by the next run.

nodes.label: Visual PNG Review
nodes.rationale: Structured validation cannot guarantee final AutoCAD text, arrow, or extension-line rendering, so full and detail PNG review remains mandatory.

nodes.label: Overall Dimension Priority
nodes.rationale: Overall dimensions represent the full real envelope and must not be replaced by local feature projections.

nodes.label: Real Geometry Attachment Rules
nodes.rationale: Dimension and leader endpoints must correspond to manufacturable, existing geometry rather than theoretical or floating construction points.

nodes.label: Local Boundary Placement Rules
nodes.rationale: Eligible dimensions may use a nearby valid local boundary to shorten extension lines, but their dimension line must remain outside the real contour and fall back to the global envelope when needed.

nodes.label: Recognizer and Layout Diagnostics Separation
nodes.rationale: FeatureRecognizer.DiagnosticsEnabled controls recognizer logs, while ASD4 labels are a distinct DimensionDrawer layout-debug mechanism.
